blocks.text: INDIANAPOLIS— Pascal Siakam scored 20 points, including a 3-pointer with 44.4 seconds to go, and Kelly Oubre Jr. added a season-high 20 points to help the Indiana Pacers snap a four-game losing streak with a 125-120 victory over the Oklahoma City Thunder in the NBA on Monday night. The Pacers finished 15 of 37 on 3-pointers and looked much more like the team that made the 2025 NBA Finals by pushing the tempo, knocking down long-range shots and spreading the scoring.
